metadata.source: OpenStreetMap-derived London civic, economy, service, visitor, office, and hospitality context
metadata.method: Classifies named OSM commercial, service, hospitality, visitor, office, market, and night-time economy features into gravity-lens anchors. Polygon and line anchors use centroid points for map callouts and flow links.
caveats: Current OSM context is not evidence of opening date, trading status, footfall, spending, or causal impact.
Anchor sectors are tag-derived and may be incomplete where OSM tags are sparse.
These anchors provide destination context; dated evidence records remain the year-changing source-backed layer.
